_comment: Auto-derived from PrimitiveRegistry.js, PrimitiveSchemas.js, and PrimitiveCatalog.js. Do not edit manually. Consumed by mozaiksai/core/workflow/ui_primitives.py for agent guidance injection.

DataTable.use: Use only when ResourceTable is not appropriate for dense operational data.
DataTable.avoid: Do not use as the default collection page primitive; prefer ResourceTable.

properties.columns: array of string|{key,label?,type?:text|number|date|badge|status|actions,sortable?,width?} — min 1 — Column definitions. Each entry is a string key or a column config object. — REQUIRED
properties.api_endpoint: string — Backend endpoint to fetch rows from.
properties.data: array of items — Static row data (alternative to api_endpoint).

Form.use: Use for real create/edit/settings input surfaces with clear submit and optional cancel actions.
Form.avoid: Do not generate forms without a submit path or with placeholder-only fields.

Grid.use: Use only to arrange a small number of child primitives when layout is essential.
Grid.avoid: Do not use Grid to manufacture dashboard sections.

properties.columns: integer — Number of grid columns. — REQUIRED
properties.api_endpoint: string — Optional shared data endpoint for child primitive binding.

Button.use: Use for single actions outside PageHeader, ResourceTable, or Form.
Button.avoid: Do not scatter duplicate primary CTAs across the page.

Modal.use: Use for interruptive confirmation or compact create/edit flows.
Modal.avoid: Do not hide primary page tasks in modals by default.

Alert.use: Use for important inline contextual messages.
Alert.avoid: Do not use alerts as explanatory decoration.

Skeleton.use: Use only for short in-place loading placeholders.

Empty.use: Use for simple empty states with one concise message and at most one action.
Empty.avoid: Do not repeat empty states across every section of the same page.

Timeline.use: Use for real chronological events such as deployments or approvals.
Timeline.avoid: Do not generate decorative activity feeds.

CodeBlock.use: Use for real code, config, logs, or command output.

ProgressTracker.use: Use when the user is moving through a known ordered process.
ProgressTracker.avoid: Do not use for generic lifecycle decoration.

AlertBanner.use: Use for high-priority page-level alerts that change what the user should do.
AlertBanner.avoid: Do not use banners for routine status or marketing copy.

ActionButton.use: Use for a compact cluster of related actions when PageHeader actions are not enough.
ActionButton.avoid: Do not create multiple competing primary actions.

FileList.use: Use when the page has real files or generated artifacts to show.
FileList.avoid: Do not create placeholder file lists.

PageHeader.use: Use once at the top of a durable page for title, short subtitle, and primary actions.
PageHeader.avoid: Do not repeat page scope with nearby eyebrow labels, duplicate titles, or extra heading sections.

ResourceTable.use: Use for collection/index pages that need search, filters, sorting, status, updated time, and row actions.
ResourceTable.avoid: Do not wrap ResourceTable in decorative cards or add fake analytics around it.

SummaryStrip.use: Use for 2-4 genuinely useful portfolio metrics above a collection.
SummaryStrip.avoid: Do not create generic KPI strips or more than four stats.

InlineEmptyState.use: Use inside a panel/table area when one bounded region has no data.
InlineEmptyState.avoid: Do not use as filler copy when the section itself should be omitted.

LoadingState.use: Use for full-page or full-region loading while real data is being fetched.
LoadingState.avoid: Do not use decorative skeletons when a plain loading state is enough.

ErrorState.use: Use when a page or region cannot load actionable data.
ErrorState.avoid: Do not expose internal runtime names or stack traces in user-facing errors.

Panel.use: Use for one purposeful supporting section on a detail page.
Panel.avoid: Do not nest panels or turn every fact into a panel.

SurfaceCard.use: Use for one prominent grouped surface when a panel needs stronger hierarchy.
SurfaceCard.avoid: Do not use multiple SurfaceCards to create a dashboard wall.

StatusPill.use: Use for one compact state label per object.
StatusPill.avoid: Do not show multiple badges for the same status concept.

Metric.use: Use inside a purposeful summary surface when one metric needs detail text.
Metric.avoid: Prefer SummaryStrip for page-level metrics; do not build KPI grids by default.

properties.label: string — REQUIRED
properties.value_key: string — Dot path into section api_endpoint response.
properties.detail_key: string — Dot path into section api_endpoint response.
properties.trend_key: string — Dot path into section api_endpoint response; rendered as detail when detail/detail_key is absent.

SegmentedBar.use: Use for compact proportional breakdowns with real segment values.
SegmentedBar.avoid: Do not fake charts or show decorative bars without useful data.
